name: codelink
description: Bridge WeChat with Codex conversations for remote continuation and task notifications.

interface.shortDescription: Continue Codex conversations and receive task updates in WeChat.
interface.longDescription: CodeLink keeps one current Codex conversation per WeChat user. Messages continue it by default; users can start a new conversation naturally, and notifications from any Codex task bind that task so later WeChat replies continue there.
defaultPrompt: 检查 CodeLink 微信连接和当前会话状态。
任务完成后通过微信通知我，并把这个任务设为微信当前会话。
把当前进度发到微信，我稍后从微信继续。
